description: This file defines data structures and a storage service for managing notes using SQLite. It includes a Note dataclass, and a StorageService class with methods for CRUD operations, filtering, pagination, and search functionality on notes.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: Represents a note entity with fields for ID, title, content, tags, archived status, creation, and last update timestamps, including methods for creation from a database row and conversion to a dictionary.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with an SQLite database for creating, reading, updating, deleting, archiving, and searching notes, with support for filters and pagination.

methods.name: str _now_iso()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC time in ISO 8601 format without timezone info.

methods.name: Note.from_row
methods.description: Creates a Note instance from a sqlite3.Row object.

methods.name: Note.to_dict
methods.description: Converts a Note instance into a serializable dictionary.

methods.name: StorageService.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the storage service, setting the database path and ensuring the database is set up.

methods.name: sqlite3.Connection _get_conn(self)
methods.description: Creates and returns a new SQLite connection with row factory set.

methods.name: None _init_db(self)
methods.description: Creates the notes table if it does not exist.

methods.name: StorageService.list_notes
methods.description: Lists notes with optional filters (e.g., archived, tags, date ranges) and pagination support, returning notes and metadata.

methods.name: StorageService.get_note
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: StorageService.create_note
methods.description: Creates a new note with provided data, generating ID and timestamps.

methods.name: StorageService.update_note
methods.description: Updates an existing note with new data; returns updated note or None if not found.

methods.name: StorageService.delete_note
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID; returns True if deletion was successful.

methods.name: StorageService.soft_archive
methods.description: Marks a note as archived without deleting it; returns the updated note or None if not found.

methods.name: StorageService.soft_restore
methods.description: Restores a soft-archived note by setting archived to False; returns the updated note or None.

methods.name: StorageService.search
methods.description: Performs a simple search across title, content, and tags with optional inclusion of archived notes, supporting pagination.
